verses.text: Jericho was on full lockdown because Israel was nearby. Nobody went out, and nobody got in. 🔒
Yahweh told Joshua, ‘Look, I’ve handed Jericho over to you—its king and its mighty warriors too. 🏰
‘All your fighting men should circle the city once. Do that for six days. 🚶
‘Seven priests should carry seven ram’s-horn trumpets ahead of the ark. On day seven, circle the city seven times while the priests blow the trumpets. 📯
‘When they let out one long blast on the ram’s horn and you hear that trumpet, everybody shout loud. Then the city wall will fall flat, and the people can go straight in.’ 📣
Joshua son of Nun called the priests and told them, ‘Pick up the covenant ark. Seven priests, take seven ram’s-horn trumpets and go ahead of Yahweh’s ark.’ 🛐
Then he told the people, ‘Move out! Circle the city, and let the armed men march ahead of Yahweh’s ark.’ 🛡️
Once Joshua had spoken, the seven priests carrying the seven ram’s-horn trumpets went forward, blowing them, and Yahweh’s covenant ark followed behind. 📯
The armed men marched ahead of the priests with the trumpets, and the ark followed after them. The trumpets kept sounding as they went. ⚔️
Joshua told everyone, ‘No shouting, no voices, not even one word from your mouth until I tell you, “Shout!” Then you shout.’ 🤫
So Yahweh’s ark circled the city once. Then they went back to camp and stayed there. 🏕️
Joshua got up early the next morning, and the priests picked up Yahweh’s ark. 🌅

The seven priests carrying the seven ram’s-horn trumpets kept marching ahead of Yahweh’s ark, blowing the trumpets. The armed men went in front, and the rear guard came behind the ark. The trumpets kept sounding. 📯
On day two, they circled the city once and went back to camp. They kept that up for six days. 🔁
At dawn on day seven, they got up early and circled the city the same way—seven times. That was the one day they did seven full laps. 🌅
On the seventh lap, the priests blew the trumpets, and Joshua told the people, ‘Shout! Yahweh has handed you the city! 📣
‘The city and everything in it is devoted to Yahweh. Only Rahab the prostitute and everyone in her house will live, because she hid the messengers we sent. 🏠
‘But watch yourselves around everything devoted for destruction. Don’t take any of it. If you do, Israel’s camp will be marked for destruction and you’ll bring trouble on it. ⚠️
‘All the silver, gold, and bronze and iron objects are holy to Yahweh. They go into Yahweh’s treasury.’ 🪙
The people shouted, and the priests blew the trumpets. When the people heard the trumpet, they let out a huge shout. The wall fell flat, and everyone went straight in and took the city. 🏰
They struck down everyone in the city with the sword—men and women, young and old—and the cattle, sheep, and donkeys too. ⚔️
Joshua told the two men who had scouted the land, ‘Go into the prostitute’s house and bring her and everyone with her out, just like you swore.’ 🗣️
The young scouts went in and brought out Rahab, her dad, her mom, her brothers, and everything she had. They brought out all her relatives too and left them outside Israel’s camp. 🤝
They burned the city and everything in it. But they put the silver, gold, and bronze and iron objects into the treasury of Yahweh’s house. 🔥
Joshua kept Rahab the prostitute, her father’s household, and all she had alive. She still lives among Israel to this day, because she hid the messengers Joshua sent to scout Jericho. 🏠

Back then Joshua made them swear this oath: ‘Whoever rebuilds this city of Jericho before Yahweh will pay for it with his firstborn when he lays the foundation, and with his youngest when he sets up the gates.’ 📜
Yahweh was with Joshua, and word about him spread through the whole land. ✨
